items.title: Sonny Igoe interviewed by Monk Rowe, Emerson, New Jersey, July 31, 2003
items.q: They came on “The Garry Moore Show” several times and that’s where I played them.

ctx.x: Yeah, when they first started doing all the shows around New York, you know the T.V. shows. They came on “The Garry Moore Show” several times and that’s where I played them.
And you guys would be in the pit?
